headline: This area covers a single planning task: reviewing the current state of the Cowork Local platform's core building blocks — its tool/context protocol, search and retrieval, agent and skill framework, LLM routing and integration points — and deciding which parts to reuse, improve, or build in-house; the code review could not confirm its status either way.
what_is_there: The task is a written assessment and classification exercise rather than a piece of software, so there is no feature in the product that would demonstrate it is done. The nearby code that was examined relates to connectors and sandbox security settings, which are not part of producing such an assessment.
what_is_unclear: Whether the assessment has been carried out is unclear, because its output would be a document or decision record rather than code, and the analysis only looked at source code.
suggested_action: Ask the owner to point to the assessment document or decision record, and attach it to the ticket so its status can be judged from the deliverable itself.
